text: @firefly0621/dsh-always-apply（DSH 插件，Web）：把工作区中的 .mdc 项目规则加入 DSH 会话的系统提示词。插件在 system-prompt/assemble 阶段读取规则；始终应用的规则会自动附加，带文件 glob 的规则会按会话涉及路径匹配，并提供规则设置面板。适合希望将项目约定持续提供给 DSH 的开发者。规则默认从工作区 .dsh/rules 读取；安装命令会同时加入浏览器规则设置界面。

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply is a DSH Web plugin that adds workspace .mdc rules to session prompts. It attaches always-applied rules and matches glob rules against paths in the session. A companion rules settings panel is included. Rules default to .dsh/rules.
想让 DSH 每次对话都自动带上项目里的规则。
能否根据当前讨论或读写的文件，自动加载匹配的项目约定？
I want to manage workspace rule files from DSH settings and have applicable ones added to the session prompt.
@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply 的功能「项目规则注入」：提示词组装时读取 .dsh/rules 中的 .mdc 规则，将始终应用或匹配会话路径的规则加入系统提示词。

Opt-in Cordis consumer that loads **Cursor-aligned project rules** from `.dsh/rules/**/*.mdc` and injects them into the system prompt. Cordis plugin name: `rules`. Prompt section: `rules:project`.

This package does **not** read skills or depend on `ctx.skills`. Mount it when you want project rules; install with:

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · Table of Contents：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @firefly0621/dsh-always-apply
```

Or insert the shipped `cordis.patch.yml` into a custom base. That patch also inserts the browser Settings「规则」panel (`@firefly0621/dsh-client-ui-settings-rules`); that client package is a dependency of this host plugin so one install resolves both Loader rows.

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · Rule files：Place `.mdc` files under `<session cwd>/.dsh/rules/` (override with Config `rulesDir`). Each file needs YAML frontmatter:

| `alwaysApply` | `globs` | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `true` | * | Always Apply — full body every assemble |
| `false` | non-empty | Specific Files — body when an in-context path matches |
| `false` | empty | Inactive — stored on disk but not auto-attached |

Only `alwaysApply: true` classifies as Always Apply. `alwaysApply: false` without `globs` is never treated as always.

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · Rule files：```yaml
---
alwaysApply: true
description: Repo-wide constraints
---

Bodies must not contain complete `{{...}}` prompt-variable groups (skipped with a warning).

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · Behavior：1. Skip agentless assemblies and `subagent` sessions by default (`skipSubagent`).
2. Load `.mdc` rules from the resolved rules root (cached; invalidated on Settings write/delete and on external edits when `watchRules` is enabled).
3. Auto-attach Always bodies and Specific bodies whose globs match v1 in-context paths (tool `read`/`write`/`edit` `file_path` values ∪ path tokens in user message text).
4. Honor `maxTotalBytes` for the complete auto-attached section text (drop Specific before Always when over budget).

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · Behavior：Also registers:

- **`projectRules` Typert remote** — `list` / `read` / `write` / `delete` for Settings and host callers.

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · Config：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `rulesDir` | `.dsh/rules` | Relative directory under the session workspace root; absolute paths and `..` are rejected. |
| `skipSubagent` | `true` | Skip subagent-origin sessions. |
| `maxTotalBytes` | `100000` | UTF-8 length of the complete auto-attached section text (reminder + bodies + framing as rendered). |
| `watchRules` | `true` | Watch each accessed rules root and invalidate the cache on external `.mdc` edits (debounced). |
| `watchDebounceMs` | `100` | Watcher debounce window in milliseconds before cache invalidation. |
| `defaultWorkspaceRoot` | *(empty)* | Absolute workspace root used when no session workspace is available. Enables the Settings UI to manage rules without an active session. Must be an absolute path. |

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · Version compatibility：This bundle declares `peerDependencies` on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages. DSH checks those ranges against the running runtime at install and profile startup; an incompatible pair is refused unless the profile grants an exact `package@version` × `dsh-version` exemption. Source-workspace `workspace:*` peers mean the matching DSH release; packed manifests substitute that exact version. See the [plugin manager's compatibility reference](../../boot/plugin-manager/README.md#version-compatibility-and-exemptions) for `version-exemptions`, `allow-version`, and the crash/data-loss risk.

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · What the model sees：When non-empty: a `rules:project` system-prompt section with a short reminder and `<auto_attached_rules>` / `<rule_content>` blocks for all auto-attached rules (Always and matching Specific).
@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · Token effect：One section re-sent each request while rules and in-context matches stay within budget.

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · KV Cache effect：Prefix reuse holds while the rendered section text is unchanged; a rules-file write, delete, or Specific match set change recomposes the section.

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- No runtime invariant companion is published; this package listens on `system-prompt/assemble` and derives injection from on-disk `.mdc` rules, with no independently observable durable relation beyond that consumer behavior.
- **Opt-in only** — product defaults do not mount this plugin.
- **No `.cursor/rules` import** — storage is `.dsh/rules` only.
- **In-context paths are incomplete vs Cursor IDE** — no open-editor inventory on the web host; Specific matching uses tool-touched paths and user-text path tokens only.
- **A complete persona replaces every section** — presets with a `complete` persona suppress this section for that agent.
- **Typert client artifacts** — the gateway registers at runtime; web Settings must compose a client that can call `projectRules` once the remote is on the host API surface.

@firefly0621/dsh-always-apply README · Dev Note：The package owns rule discovery, matching, and prompt rendering. The Settings page is a separate client package that edits the same files through the host remote API.
